label: At GO, fires after a2 reached S2 and was rewarded following an unrewarded trial.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief_lo < 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r")
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2)
explanation: GO-only feature (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude is driven by a fresh reward for a2 at S2 (common) after a loss: last trial a2 S2 rewarded with the trial before unrewarded gives the large activations (~1.0-1.5); a second consecutive reward gives only ~0.1-0.3. A small extra lift for any reward when the observer belief favours S2. Other previous-trial patterns, incl. a2 S1 rare rewarded, leave it near zero. Free fit adds belief_lo interaction (weaker when belief already strongly S2) and an episode-time fade, and slightly lower GO baseline after S1. Largest misses: first trial of a window, where the previous trial is outside the window and history is unknown.
